plain.authorization: explicit Plain binding; fresh authenticated fixed-origin TLS read; independently provisioned installation and node identity
plain.response: complete strict bounded response; exact requested project, environment and group; no E2E fallback; encrypted projects rejected
plain.state: explicit protected mode Plain, head null, no witness checkpoint annotation or status claim
plain.rollout: fresh authenticated Plain read plus protected state, exact target/deployment UIDs, opt-in and resourceVersion CAS
plain.outage: retain last target and application; no new or resumed rollout until a fresh successful authorized read
plain.trust: strict plain-v1 schemaVersion 1, or fully validated independently pinned E2E2 schemaVersion 2 for mixed non-HA installation

implementation.e2e2: existing signed envelopes, encrypted key wraps, independent witness proofs and canonical journal/fencing gates remain mandatory

implementation.immutableConfiguration: retain prior immutable ConfigMap revisions by default; reviewed cleanup only after consumers are removed

acceptance: real Helm install, Store, Plain/E2E2 target Secret, envFrom application, changed values and optional rollout
Secret volume reload in same process, rollout disabled, and unchanged published agent init plus sidecar
panel unavailable before first target and after working target, sealed panel, revoked access, incorrect E2E key

actual same-Pod projected JWT file rotation, separate real signer/JWKS overlap and retirement on disposable control plane
two namespace and administrative Store isolation, forbidden sources and targets, current logs, Events and status privacy
real install, upgrade and uninstall on two exact Kubernetes minor versions; bounded repeated-fault soak
full independent cryptographic corpus parity across Go, Python and WebCrypto, including AuthorityProof v2
meaningful unit negatives, race, static analysis, dependency vulnerabilities and full changed-source privacy review
UID-pinned cleanup of owned resources and verification that background workloads and foreign local containers are unchanged

evidence.safeReport: versions, public digests, scenario outcomes and counts only; no private endpoints, real names, credentials or secret hashes

nonClaims: Trial storage does not establish independent production fault domains or physical WORM guarantees
Plain trusts the authorized panel and provides no publisher/witness cryptographic authenticity or monotonic freshness
A kind cluster without an enforcing CNI does not prove NetworkPolicy packet isolation
Two replicas on one physical host do not prove independent host-failure resilience
No cross-object transaction or exactly-once workload restart guarantee
Existing cluster control plane, global Docker/WSL configuration and production applications are outside the mutation scope
No stage 8, release, commit, push or production deployment is authorized by this acceptance stage
